title: SQL WHERE Clause — WebCheatSheet
summary: A short free reference page from WebCheatSheet on the SQL WHERE clause: the SELECT ... FROM ... WHERE syntax with one worked example combining two conditions, plus two practical tips: test for missing values with IS NULL rather than = NULL, and pass user-supplied values as query parameters instead of building SQL strings by hand. Brief rather than a full lesson, it is useful as a quick refresher while writing queries; the previous and next pages on the site cover reading query results and AND/OR conditions. No account needed.

title: PHPRunner — web application builder for databases (Xlinesoft)
summary: PHPRunner is commercial software from Xlinesoft that generates a PHP web application from an existing database: list, add, edit, search and report pages, logins with user groups and permissions, charts and dashboards. It works with MySQL, MariaDB, SQL Server, PostgreSQL, Oracle, SQLite and others. Cost: paid, from $599 for a single developer (educational discounts by request), with a free trial download. Without buying anything, a student can browse nine live demo applications (read-only) that show what a finished interface over a relational database looks like: master-detail pages, permissions, reports. A tool for building database front ends, not a course in SQL or database design.
